findings.highlight: since Sakura gave it to me.
findings.evidenceJa: いつも桜が用意してくれてる
findings.governingReading: Shirou trusts the handkerchief's cleanliness because Sakura regularly prepares one for him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's regular preparation of his handkerchief becomes her supplying this one, leaving the recurring care unstated.

findings.highlight: I knew there was another Master
findings.evidenceJa: 学校にわたしたち以外のマスターがいるって事は知ってた
findings.governingReading: 学校にわたしたち以外のマスターがいる specifies the school as the already-known locus.
findings.explanation: Rin’s prior knowledge of another Master at school becomes merely knowing another Master exists.

findings.highlight: You'll die from necrosis if we leave that wound be.
findings.evidenceJa: その傷、治療しないと壊死しちゃう
findings.governingReading: The untreated wound would necrose; the next condition is the arm no longer moving.
findings.explanation: Predicted necrosis and loss of arm function gain a predicted death.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしの落ち度みたい
findings.governingReading: わたしの落ち度みたい says it would look like her failing, within her excuse for taking him home to treat the wound.
findings.explanation: Rin’s face-saving appearance of fault becomes direct acceptance of fault.

findings.evidenceJa: なんでもなにもないわよ
findings.governingReading: なんでもなにもないわよ responds that there is no question of why, immediately explaining the evident need for treatment.
findings.explanation: A dismissal of asking why becomes there is no reason.

findings.highlight: There are Western-style houses near the top
findings.evidenceJa: 洋風の建物が住宅地の一番上
findings.governingReading: 洋風の建物が住宅地の一番上 locates the described Tohsaka building at the very top.
findings.explanation: The one Western building at the top becomes plural Western houses near the top.
